fields.title: The Section That Passes Review
fields.keyTakeaway: A seven-point section captures data, basis, minimization, retention, deletion, access, and threats, and is sufficient if it allows evaluating processing lawfulness without questions.
fields.sections/0/blocks/0/text: How to structure data decisions so legal and security do not send the spec back?
fields.sections/1/blocks/0/text: Each round of clarifications costs calendar days. A section covering typical questions eliminates most of them before the first reading.
fields.sections/2/blocks/1/text: **1. What data is affected.** New fields, new sources, new recipients.
fields.sections/2/blocks/2/text: **2. Legal basis for processing.** For each new type: contract, legal obligation, legitimate interest, consent.
fields.sections/2/blocks/3/text: **3. Minimization.** What was decided not to collect and why. Shows the question was thought through.
fields.sections/2/blocks/4/text: **4. Retention period.** For each new type. No answer implies "forever."
fields.sections/2/blocks/5/text: **5. Deletion.** What happens upon account deletion: deleted, anonymized, retained due to obligations.
fields.sections/2/blocks/6/text: **6. Access.** Who sees this data: roles, our employees, partners, subprocessors.
fields.sections/2/blocks/7/text: **7. Threat analysis.** Link to the result if the feature went through triage, or rationale for why it did not.
fields.sections/2/blocks/8/text: Plus **consents**, if applicable: which one, when requested, how revoked, what happens upon refusal.
fields.sections/2/blocks/9/text: Sufficiency check: **can a lawyer determine processing lawfulness from this section without asking questions?**
fields.sections/3/blocks/0/text: Section for the courier messaging feature, abbreviated:
fields.sections/3/blocks/1/text: > **Data.** New entity "Message": order, sender, text, timestamp. Proxy number instead of direct. Parties' direct numbers are not disclosed. > > **Basis.** Contract performance—communication is necessary for delivery. > > **Minimization.** We do not store parties' numbers in chat logs. We do not store courier geolocation in messages. We do not index text for search. > > **Retention.** 30 days after order completion, then deletion. For dispute tickets—6 months. > > **Account deletion.** Buyer messages are anonymized, text retained 30 days for investigating delivery disputes, then deleted. > > **Access.** Order parties. Support—upon request, with an audit log. Partner store does not see it. Subprocessors—proxy number provider. > > **Threats.** Review from 12.03, table of 6 threats, two mitigations changed the feature. > > **Consents.** Not required, basis is contract performance.
fields.sections/3/blocks/2/text: The section passed review on the first try. Before introducing the template, similar features went through two or three rounds.
fields.sections/4/blocks/0/text: The template does not replace the review: it documents decisions, while they are made during discovery and threat modeling.
fields.sections/5/blocks/0/text: A seven-point section captures data, basis, minimization, retention, deletion, access, and threats, and is sufficient if it allows evaluating processing lawfulness without questions.
